messages:
Ana (Design): dropped a new exploration for the Rollouts panel. compact list + inline preview diff when you hover/focus a version. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rollouts/preview-diff. main asks: (1) make rollback quick but reversible, (2) provide a small preview of config/traffic diff before commit, (3) keyboard-first behaviour. thoughts?
Leo (PM): big +1 for preview diffs. product wants a visible mini-diff that shows what will change (routes, env flags, weight). prefer explicit CTA text that names the target version (e.g., "Rollback to v5.6") so logs are clear. also consider adding a hotkey to start the rollback flow for power users.
Priyanka (Eng): preview diff is doable. implementation notes: we can render a tiny snapshot on hover using cached diffs; for keyboard focus we'll need the same DOM node to avoid hover-only. hotkey fine ("r") but be careful to gate it behind focused row to avoid global accidental triggers. virtualization required for long lists.
Rowan (A11y): accessibility points: never rely on hover for critical info. ensure the preview diff is reachable with Tab or arrow keys. add `aria-expanded` to rows and `aria-controls` to the preview panel. when preview changes announce: "Preview: route /api toggled, canary 5%" using aria-live="polite". hotkeys must be documented and announced; provide a visible tooltip for keyboard users (aria-describedby).
deploy-bot: quick scan: contrast issue on small diff text (#7F878B on #FFFFFF) ratio 3.0:1. recommended #5A6164 for small text.
Ana (Design): ok will darken the tiny diff text. copy choice for CTA: 1) "Rollback to v{X}" 2) "Reinstate previous" 3) "Revert to v{X}"  which is clearest? also thinking of helper text under CTA: "Undo within 10 minutes."
Leo (PM): pick 1 or 3. 1 is concise and useful for logs. 2 is ambiguous. A/B test 1 vs 3 later if we want. include undo TTL microcopy.
Priyanka (Eng): prefer 1 as well. for hotkey: 'r' to open inline confirm then Enter to confirm, Escape to cancel. we'll implement a short debounce to avoid double-press. also, include analytics event with version id on confirm.
Rowan (A11y): on hotkeys, ensure users can disable them (settings) and that they only activate when a row has focus. screen readers should get an announcement like "Hotkey R available: start rollback for focused version." Consider adding a small assistive text region for hotkeys.
Ana (Design): about preview diff density: showing all changed keys can be noisy. proposal: show top 3 diffs inline, then a "Show more" that opens a details drawer. that drawer should be modal for high-risk changes only.
Leo (PM): top 3 diffs sounds good. modal only for rollbacks that affect infra or DB migrations. inline drawer for service/config diffs. keep audit entries consistent: "User Y rolled back Service Z: v5.6 -> v5.5".
Priyanka (Eng): technical: differ between two modes easily: small JSON diff render (syntax highlighted) for drawer, and a condensed bullet list for inline preview. ensure syntax highlight colors meet contrast for code text. caching diffs will keep perf fast.
Rowan (A11y): for the condensed preview use semantic lists and ensure code blocks have role="textbox" with aria-label so SR users can read snippets. drawer modals: use role="dialog" and trap focus; inline preview: role="region" with aria-live updates on changes.
deploy-bot: suggestion: add aria-atomic=true on preview changes to avoid partial announcements.
Ana (Design): action items: 1) update figma to show "Rollback to v{X}" CTA, helper copy "Undo within 10 minutes", and top-3 inline diffs; 2) annotate keyboard hotkey behaviour and focus rules; 3) darken small diff text to #5A6164 and add aria-live/atomic notes. will post updated frames by EOD.
Leo (PM): I'll open an experiment ticket for hotkey opt-in and CTA wording A/B. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-1045.
Priyanka (Eng): I'll prototype cached diff render and the keyboard handlers. will link demo GIF here.
Rowan (A11y): I'll re-run accessibility smoke once figma updates are posted. checklist: preview reachable by keyboard, aria-controls/expanded, aria-live polite + atomic, hotkey discoverability.
Ana (Design): thanks team  will post the annotated figma and a short explainer gif when ready. :sparkles:
